jobs.label: MIRV nuclear warhead detonation
jobs.description: One fictional nuclear warhead explosion seen EXACTLY from above: keys1-2 white blinding circular flash;3-4 expanding luminous yellow-white disk;5-6 hot orange spherical fireball TOP;7-9 broad pale concentric pressure shockwave ring around orange-white central bloom;10-11 cooling amber center surrounded by large concentric gray-brown billow tops;12-15 lingering broad slate/ash cloud viewed overhead, gradually thinner and fading. Peak diameter275px with18px transparent cell margin, no cropped ring. All expansion centered at same fixed coordinate. Absolutely no side-on mushroom silhouette or vertical stem, no horizon, landscape or destruction scene. Only standalone VFX. Sixteen stages including final empty.
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint a TOP-DOWN game explosion animation atlas, for Age of Fronts. 1254x1254 RGBA in an EXACT 4x4 uniform grid, sixteen 314x314 cells, ordered left-to-right then next row. Same fixed central impact point at the geometric CENTER of EVERY cell. True transparent alpha outside fire/smoke/glow, including between cells. Vertical overhead orthographic view of circular/irregular cloud TOPS, never side view or mushroom profile. Hand-painted volumetric shaded fire and smoke with crisp luminous core and soft alpha edge. No ground texture patch, vehicles, target silhouettes, text, frame numbers, grid lines, border, checkerboard or opaque canvas. Each key is fully contained with 18px clear border, never spill across cells. Key 16 (bottom-right cell) must be completely empty transparent. IMPORTANT OVERRIDE: max TOTAL diameter of each effect INCLUDING shockwave and all glow haze is210px, with50px completely clear transparent margin in EACH314pxcell. Expansion grows small20pxflash to210pxpeak, no big full-cell blast. Keep15progressive centered effect poses and last16entirelyblank.
